TREATMENT OF STROKE
Depends on the cause(s)
Treatment Goals
- Restore circulation and ensure brain perfusion by elevating the legs to
increase venous return
- Identify cause and treat accordingly
- Prevent recurrence
Non-drug Treatment
- Physiotherapy: pressure stockings
Drug Treatment
- Specific treatment for cardiac arrhythmias: Please refer to cardiologist
- If hypotensive, give pressor agents
Notable Adverse Drug Reactions, Contraindications and Caution
- Aspirin and other NSAIDs: use with caution in patients with history of
dyspepsia, and in asthmatics
Prevention
- Avoid prolonged standing
- Treat underlying cardiac disease
- Avoid dehydration or excessive fluid loss
- Ensure adequate calorie and avoid prolonged fasting
- Use medication as prescribed by physicians and avoid overdosage to
compensate for missed doses
